note: The demo catalog fixtures every example hardcodes or the gallery links, and the semantic invariants ci/check-fixtures.mjs asserts before the browser sweep runs. Verified against https://demo.getgeolens.com/api on 2026-08-28, GeoLens 1.16.1. A tile probe names one z/x/y inside that dataset's footprint: Manhattan for the subway lines, the Matterhorn summit for the DEM. `grep` is the substring that finds this fixture everywhere it is written down in this repo. `computedFrom` records the page layout a bbox was derived from, since a change to that layout moves the box the page requests.

export.why: duckdb/query.py reads this export with DuckDB's read_parquet over HTTP, which needs the route to answer anonymously and to serve byte ranges
maplibre/pmtiles.html commits a copy of this export and documents the command that cut it; the probe keeps that command honest

maplibre/pmtiles-live.html points the pmtiles protocol straight at this export URL from another origin, which needs the route to answer anonymously, serve byte ranges, and send the CORS headers GeoLens 1.16.1 added
